system_prompt_style.note: System prompt construction lives in crowd-agent-backend/config/prompt.yml and truncated part of crowdagent.py; not shown. Paper: QA agent guidelines 'formatted into a system prompt' for LLM annotators (suggests dynamic, but not for the scheduling agent).

env_context_strategy.note: Not a repository-navigation harness; scheduling agent receives messages from shared pool. Prompt assembly not shown.

context_compaction.note: State messages accumulate via `Annotated[list[str], add]`; the node that calls the LLM is in truncated code, so compaction cannot be confirmed.

observation_format.note: Tool results are short text ToolMessages. Line numbers not given in evidence.

tool_call_format.note: LangChain @tool with ChatOpenAI tool_calls; LangGraph ToolNode imported.

tool_count.note: At least 5 @tool definitions visible (human, llm, vlm, text_slm, visual_slm); frontend maps a 6th (multi_modal_slm_annotate_tool). The tool list bound to the model is in truncated code.

edit_primitive.note: The tools are annotation dispatch tools only. No file-editing tool appears among the defined tools.

tool_schema_source.note: LangChain @tool derives the schema from the signature and docstring. The docstrings are hand-written descriptions.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file is in the bundle, and no grep result is available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: all agents adhere to the ReAct-style behavior described by Yao et al. (2023)
loop_primitives.note: LangGraph StateGraph runs annotation, then QA, then financing, then scheduling in multi-round loop (paper Fig. 3). Graph edges are in truncated code.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the agent is designed to reflect on and learn from its own past scheduling decisions to refine its strategy over time
planning_granularity.note: The SimpleState fields show no plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Utilizes specialized agents for Scheduling, Quality Assurance (QA), and Financing to automate workflow management.
multi_agent_topology.note: Fixed round sequence of specialised agents (scheduling to annotation, QA, profile, financing) over a shared message pool. Could also be read as orchestrator_workers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Communication between agents is facilitated through the exchange of structured files and a shared message pool.
delegation_mechanism.note: Implemented as a shared LangGraph state messages list.

human_in_loop.note: `from langgraph.types import interrupt` is imported, but its use is in truncated code. The paper mentions 'Human Intervention Scheduling'. Human annotators are workers, not gates.

short_term_state.note: Fields include loop_count, budget, confidence_threshold, and rules_path.

long_term_memory.note: Cross-round profiles and rules are within one run. Whether anything persists across runs is not shown.

state_persistence.note: MemorySaver (in-memory checkpointer) is imported. The script also deletes task_extra_info.yml at start. Its use is in truncated code.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The QA Agent evaluates label quality using golden samples and performs label aggregation
self_verification.note: The QA agent uses golden-set accuracy (Bayesian aggregation) plus LLM analysis. This is the closest value.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This iter- ative process continues until a predefined termi- nation condition is met
retry_policy.note: Multi-round re-annotation until convergence, budget, or max iterations. Closest value.

rollback.note: No evidence of a revert mechanism, and the registry was only partly shown.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: such as the budget being exhausted, the maximum number of iterations be- ing reached, or all samples achieving their target confidence score
termination_condition.note: test_pass is the closest value for convergence. model_declared is assumed from the scheduling agent routing to END; that code is not shown.

cost_controls.note: The monetary budget is in state. The scheduling agent routes annotation across LLM, SLM, and human sources by cost.

execution_isolation.note: Tools are Python functions run in-process on the host. 'none' also fits; subprocess was chosen as the closest value.

tracing.note: Message chunks are serialised to YAML per task, plus log files. LangSmith tracing is present only as commented-out code.

eval_hooks.note: Weak. The file tree shows validation.py, and evaluation against golden sets is built in; the quote is not verbatim.

open_source.note: No LICENSE file in the tree.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This repository contains the official implementation for the system demo paper

first_release_date.note: No tags or first-commit date in the evidence. Paper v1 is dated 17 Sep 2025, but the precise date comes only from the arXiv stamp.

pinned_version.note: The ref comes from the evidence header, commit:main 05a74f985252, with no tag.
